# Getting Help

> ⚠️ qui-sync is in **early development** — expect rough edges. Feedback genuinely wanted.

## Discord (questions, feedback, usage)

Join the [TRaSH Guides Discord](https://trash-guides.info/discord) and head to **[#qui-sync](https://discordapp.com/channels/492590071455940612/1495687451531018352)** under Community Apps. Best place for:

- Early-dev feedback — UX, naming, confusing flows
- Usage questions
- Discussion about rule organization / naming conventions
- Feature suggestions

## GitHub Issues (bugs)

[File a bug report](https://github.com/prophetse7en/qui-sync/issues/new) if you hit a reproducible problem. Please include:

- qui-sync image tag (`:dev`)
- Qui version you're pointing at
- Steps to reproduce
- Browser console output if UI-related

## Documentation

- [README](../README.md) — overview + install
- [How-To Guide](../docs/how-to.md) — detailed walkthroughs of every feature
